title: On Daring to say it out loud
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：dare　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dare 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the coach ① dared to say it out loud with great care, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② dares to say it out loud on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ dare to say it out loud at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ dared to say it out loud before — a line in the record for April 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Daring to say it out loud with great care, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ dare to open the door first on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Dare to open the door first at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ dares to open the door first with great care every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ dared to say it out loud again when nobody else would.

⑩ To dare to say it out loud, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody dares to say it out loud on the same day again and somebody must dare to say it out loud with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 敢（一般过去式 dared to say it out loud：1972 年教练头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 敢（一般现在 dares to say it out loud：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 敢（不定式 to dare to say it out loud：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 敢（过去完成时 had dared to say it out loud：1966 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 敢（动名词 daring to say it out loud 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 敢于（dare to open the door first：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去敢于敢头一个去开门）
G. v. 敢于（dare to open the door first：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 敢（后段两处：新来的队员照例 dares to open the door first，而母亲又一次 dared to say it out loud）

answers.why: dare 意为“敢”，1972 年教练小心翼翼地敢敢把那句话大声说出来，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 dared。
dare 意为“敢”，自那以后教练当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 dares。
dare 意为“敢”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯敢敢把那句话大声说出来”，此处为不定式 to dare to say it out loud。
dare 意为“敢”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1979 年之前就有人敢过，故用过去完成时 had dared。
dare 意为“敢”，教练说“敢敢把那句话大声说出来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 daring to say it out loud 作主语。
dare 意为“敢于”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去敢于敢头一个去开门”，should ever 之后用原形 dare to open the door first。
dare 意为“敢于”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻敢于敢头一个去开门（dare to open the door first at once），以后再也不要提起。
dare 意为“敢”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例敢于敢头一个去开门，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 dares。
dare 意为“敢”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地敢敢把那句话大声说出来，用一般过去式 dared 叙述。
dare 意为“敢”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要敢敢把那句话大声说出来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 dare 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the coach dared to say it out loud with great care, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach dares to say it out loud on the same day whenever the field asks.
Daring to say it out loud with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever dare to open the door first on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field dares to open the door first with great care every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother dared to say it out loud again, and the field remembered that half.
